title: Spirit Legion
notes: LEGION REWORKED: the Legion is now made of magic spirits. They float behind you, only cast ranged bolts, can't be hurt and each gives a strong bonus (ATK, HP, Crit, Gold Find, Lifesteal).
Spirits are bought with Gold, not dropped. Level them up with Gold. You start with 1 slot and can buy slot 2 and 3. Your old monsters were turned into Gold.
NEW: Gold Rush and Training in the Gates tab. Play them as often as you like for lots of Gold or XP (no loot). Stuck on a floor? Train and come back.
Easier start: E-Rank enemies are softer, so you progress fast even by just spamming SPACE. D and C Rank are tougher, that's where gear, skills and spirits matter.
Item window is compact: Equip, Lock and Salvage sit at the top, no scrolling.
Salvage now returns 65% of the Gold and Mana Stones you spent on enhancing that item.
Defeat screen tells you exactly what helps (Training, Gold Rush, skills, AUTO FARM, spirits).
